# Checkpoint 10 — signed spatial tables for radius 4

All differences are the spatial-label result minus the original material result. The full depth force includes the common field load. Stored energy and the order-shift component use the same frozen material quadrature points. Degree refers to the Gauss rule used in each direction.

## Spatial buckets

A is the ordered interior outside both neighborhoods. B contains cells touching the physical weld and their immediate neighbors. C contains cells touching any folded prism or the boundary between active and fully melted cells, with one layer of neighbors. A neighbor shares a face, edge or vertex on the native spatial grid. Cells in both neighborhoods are assigned to C. The last table in this section reports the effect of assigning those cells to B.
